_comment: Settings of the suite -> bug -> retest cycle (see .claude/skills/suite-bug-cycle/SKILL.md). Fill the <...> values for your project; nothing here is a secret - the tracker login is the one git already has.
_phone_comment: Suites matching phoneSuites drive the phone: they run one at a time and wait while appiumPort is in use.
_failure_comment: knockOnPattern: messages that mean 'an earlier block failed, nothing to work on' (RunContext.get's message is the default). envIssuePattern: the machine or the run's set-up, never a product bug. volatilePatterns: generated values (the run's own user names, stamps) replaced before failures of two attempts are compared.
knockOnPattern: Nothing saved as ".*" in this run
envIssuePattern: MAIL_APP_PASSWORD is not set|EADDRINUSE|instrumentation process is not running|Could not start a new session|session not created|Timed out receiving message from renderer
_leftovers_comment: Console lines your set-up and clean-up blocks print, as regexes with the item's id / name in group 1 - e.g. created 'Created user by API: (\S+)', deleted 'Deleted user by API: (\S+)'. cleanup = how to remove a leftover, shown in the summary. Empty = not tracked.
_tracker_comment: bugcycle/ado.js implements Azure DevOps. org = the API base, e.g. https://dev.azure.com/<organisation> ; assignTo = who receives bugs filed from automation; tags = the tag that marks them.

environmentField.Test: <value of the tracker's environment field for Test>

_retest_comment: Which env a bug is retested on, from its tracker state (the states that mean 'the fix is deployed on <env>'); a pass moves it to 'to'. A failed retest never moves a bug by itself - a person decides.
failedRetestProposal: <state to propose for a bug that is still failing, e.g. Reopened>
